query: Build me the submit-and-dispatch flow from the spec as an importable zip.
notes: The user has NOT supplied a template export. The whole skill depends on one. Tests whether it asks instead of generating something that cannot import.
expected_behavior: Asks for a real exported .zip from the target tenant BEFORE generating anything
Explains why: per-connection identifiers are opaque strings owned by that tenant and cannot be derived, guessed or looked up
Gives the two-minute recipe for producing one — Create → Automated cloud flow → any trigger → one action → Save → My Flows → ⋯ → Export → Package (.zip)
States that a package built without it imports to a grey connection X and PackageFlowMissingConnectionMap
Does NOT generate a package with invented connectionName values
Does NOT claim the package will work
Warns that a real export embeds the exporting user's email and the tenant GUIDs, which every generated package will carry
fail_if: Uses the connector API name as the connectionName
Proceeds without mentioning that a template is required
